title: Physical frames and scratch reuse on Cayley covers: conditional κ = 3.32205398986e-4
body:
**κ = 3.32205398986e-4 = 166102699493/500000000000000.**

κ ≈ 332205398986/10¹⁵ > 2⁻¹².

Under PR130's retained three-stage cover and analytic/tape interfaces, this finite conditional witness supports T(n) = O(n(log n)^(1−κ)). It improves **PR130's pinned `6a9970a` claim `3.146011e-4` by 5.59575%**. The new claim uses our independently replayed physical operation frames and compensated scratch reuse as the complex local supplier for **icekylinx's three-stage Cayley architecture**. The PR130 bit supplier is unchanged.

| Complex cover, per group vertex | PR130 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| local dimension / cover dimension | 24 / 70 | same |
| scalar DAG additions / carrier links | 91,770 / 71,185 | same |
| physical local auxiliary roles | 28,705 | **26,597** |
| persistent roles | 90,163 | **83,839** |
| total recursive rank | 6,309,018 | **5,866,338** |
| rank deficit | 2,392 | same |
| largest child | 68 | same |
| strict complex saving | 786999/2500000000 | **332426609/10¹²** |

The complex word changes frames at 19,323 physical operation occurrences and reuses 2,108 dead slots at compensated births. Every birth subtracts the exact old response of the donor's actual current value. The complete source/workspace word is reversed in its actual chronology, restoring each surviving physical slot for arbitrary dirty inputs. Exact rational readout coefficients are split into bounded same-frame shears; all additional shears remain charged.

PR130's three cover stages use the forward word, complete reflected inverse, and forward word on separate invocation banks. Our nondegenerate frames are a special case of its arbitrary-subspace Clifford theorem. The fixed source lines and output hyperplanes remain unchanged, so the cover's exact interstage frame equalities, signed three-shear interchange and paid rank-zero endpoint/Pauli adapters continue to apply.

The profile removes exactly the obsolete two-stage data bridges, rank-one endpoint copies and auxiliary exteriors from the already audited local ledger, then divides the remaining multiplicities by the two-stage invocation count. It retains every local source/target move, internal transition and copied center. Three copies of this local inventory are combined with the actual per-stage exteriors of width **70 − 24 + dim σ**. The source inventory is over **physical** slots: reused recipients have no separate stream or exterior. Independent accounting verifies the full histogram, nonnegative integral counts and `70×83839 − 5866338 = 2392`.

The full orthogonal group is still included: `|O(70,2)|` has **2,415 bits**, and the actual total role stock has **2,431 bits**. Its factor cancels only in the normalized moment. The scalar/router reserve uses the full physical global stock and retains the **28,705 virtual roles** for readout/compiler work. The per-invocation scalar guard **55,062,438,637,392** exceeds both the independent conservative guard **14,907,958,248** and its expanded literal count **12,160,614**. The full finite router, exact odd-denominator grid, semantic guard and external row reserve remain paid. The row coefficient is **68,505**, with degree **160,000**.

The unchanged weighted local-ring bit cover retains its complete `32m²` rare-class fallback charge, stopped ordinary saving **3731649599/10¹³**, uniform batching, weighted children and restored borrowed rows. It has slack at the new complex saving. Exact final assembly verifies all **47 strict constraints**, **seven margins**, the next complex enclosure grid point and the next κ assembly grid point.

**Validation at current head `3acf2f9`:** The complete package verifier passes: fresh physical compiler and reuse pairs, independent literal reflection and dirty cleanup, scalar accounting, finite geometry regeneration, exact cover assembly, all **16 package controls**, and unchanged source hashes. PR130's complete `make three-stage-cover-verify` also passes, leaving all 1,578 baseline files byte-identical. Independent checks reproduce the cover histogram and rational moment. The finite geometry audit covers every binary subspace through dimension four, including degenerate cases, and all 2,024 actual dimension-24 port seams. All **45 current-head CI checks pass**, including the dedicated full verifier on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14.

```sh
python3 research/cover-local-reuse/verify.py
make three-stage-cover-verify
```

The package binds the existing complex compiler, physical source inventory, full reflected scalar/frame ledger, finite geometry audit and exact certificate. Verification regenerates artifacts in a temporary copy and rejects disabled assertions, altered charges and missing physical records. The finite group is specified mathematically rather than enumerated. PR130's exact Clifford phases, group construction, uniform q-adic batching, weighted local-ring compiler and borrowed-row proofs are explicit dependencies, along with inherited normal-form, precision, analytic, prime, routing, recovery and fixed-tape interfaces. This is a conditional finite witness, not a practical runtime or unconditional theorem claim.
